raw_response:
The raw_customers table is an SCD2 dimension. It has 230 rows for 200 distinct customers: 200 rows with is_current=True and 30 historical rows with is_current=False. silver_customers keeps all 230 rows, so the join fans out for the 30 customers that have history. Counts are 4600 in silver and 5286 in gold, so 686 extra rows.

The fix is to keep only the current rows in silver_customers. Each of the 200 customers has exactly one current row: True=200 and distinct=200, and the 200 valid_from values of 2025-01-01 match the 200 current rows. That makes the current row unambiguous.

Should the region be as of the transaction date instead? The history rows start at 2023-06-01 and the current rows at 2025-01-01. All transactions fall in January 2026, after every current valid_from, so the current row applies to all of them. Filtering on is_current is correct.

The output columns stay the same (customer_id, region).
